name: PKSHA Technology Inc.
summary: PKSHA Technology Inc. provides algorithmic solutions in Japan. The company offers demand forecasting and optimization, shelf allocation automation and optimization, and shift optimization solutions for retail and distribution industries; VIN recognition, parking DX, urban security, and mobile-related solutions for automotive and urban development industries; and fraud detection and credit AI scoring solutions for lending and banking industries.
